delight.principle: Useful discovery and contextual human copy, preserving the Swiss visual world.
delight.wordExample: Illustrative COLD → CORD → CARD → WARD → WARM. Static path, native step/reset button, polite status, salmon changed-letter feedback and shared 300ms motion; reduced-motion fallback.
delight.navigation: Next-case descriptions and résumé PDF labels; contact links show the verified one-page format.
delight.recovery: Warm, direct 404 recovery without assuming a previous visit.

colorRoles.source: Existing Word Lawrie release artwork and approved palette

selectedWork.wordArtwork: Larger genuine artwork column; full aspect ratio, stacks beneath copy below 64rem
selectedWork.scope: Homepage Selected Work only; hero, case pages, Experience and About retain their existing hierarchy.

narrative.overview: Pronounced brutalism with Swiss typographic discipline, keeping the existing palette and IBM Plex identity.

rules.name: Public-safe work
rules.body: Employer narratives describe personal contribution and known UAT milestones; never infer production status or expose internal details.

rules.name: Visible by default
rules.body: No content depends on animation or JavaScript. Enlarged text reflows within grid tracks.

dos: Keep the original palette and fonts.
Respect portrait, landscape, keyboard and enlarged-text use.
donts: Do not restore employer workflow diagrams or contact forms.
Do not reintroduce confidential metrics or licensing terms.
Do not rely on old Operational Field comps for current requirements.
